_about: Card logos (card products) per bank: the starting catalogue. Researched from public comparison sites (Paisabazaar, BankBazaar, CardAdvisor, CardInsider, the banks' own pages) on 2026-11-28. Fees and rewards are indicative, not the banks' official terms. Read by scripts/add-logos.mjs (to build the mock warehouse) and server/logos.ts (for the app and the designer). 'share' is the logo's share of primary cards in the mock data.
